_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: shifts_one_open_per_device
data.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX shifts_one_open_per_device ON shifts (device_id)
    WHERE closed_at IS NULL;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stores" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "address" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_header" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_footer" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "legal_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "tin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_logo" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_options" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "staff_users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "pin_hash" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "units" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_fractional" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_fractional" IN (0, 1)), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "color" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "category_id" TEXT NULL, "unit_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sell_price_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_price_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_weighted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_weighted" IN (0, 1)), "plu_code" TEXT NULL, "min_stock_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "ikpu_code" TEXT NULL, "quick_button" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("quick_button" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "image_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_barcodes" ("barcode" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_primary" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_primary" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("barcode"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "debt_limit_tiyin" INTEGER NULL, "balance_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_stock" ("product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("product_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "debt_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NULL, "refund_id" TEXT NULL, "shift_id" TEXT NULL, "method" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shifts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "opened_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "opened_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_cash_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closed_by" TEXT NULL, "closed_at" TEXT NULL, "counted_cash_tiyin" INTEGER NULL, "expected_cash_tiyin" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shift_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "cashier_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, "approved_by" TEXT NULL, "number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "subtotal_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed', "debt_entry_id" TEXT NULL, "sold_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "barcode_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "price_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "received_tiyin" INTEGER NULL, "change_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "refunds" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shift_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "cashier_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "approved_by" TEXT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "total_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "debt_entry_id" TEXT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "refund_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "refund_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES refunds (id), "sale_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cash_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shift_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "by_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_receipts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NULL, "number" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "total_cost_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "posted_at" TEXT NULL, "posted_by" TEXT NULL, "corrects_id" TEXT NULL, "reverses_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_receipt_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_receipts (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_price_tiyin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "new_sell_price_tiyin" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_counts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "scope" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all', "category_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "posted_at" TEXT NULL, "posted_by" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_count_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "count_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_counts (id), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_milli" INTEGER NULL, "counted_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_id" TEXT NULL, "qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "outbox_event_id" TEXT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "sent_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "pull_cursor" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', "last_push_at" TEXT NULL, "last_pull_at" TEXT NULL, "subscription_json" TEXT NULL, "offline_grace_until" TEXT NULL, "server_time_offset_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cart_drafts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, "lines_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "discount_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "doc_counters" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_images" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX products_plu ON products (plu_code)
CREATE INDEX products_search ON products (search_key)
CREATE INDEX products_quick ON products (quick_button)
CREATE INDEX product_barcodes_product ON product_barcodes (product_id)
CREATE INDEX debt_entries_customer ON debt_entries (customer_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX shifts_one_open_per_device ON shifts (device_id) WHERE closed_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX sales_shift ON sales (shift_id)
CREATE INDEX sales_sold_at ON sales (sold_at)
CREATE INDEX sale_items_sale ON sale_items (sale_id)
CREATE INDEX sale_payments_sale ON sale_payments (sale_id)
CREATE INDEX refunds_sale ON refunds (sale_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX inventory_count_items_unique_product ON inventory_count_items (count_id, product_id)
CREATE INDEX stock_movements_product ON stock_movements (product_id)
CREATE INDEX stock_movements_event ON stock_movements (outbox_event_id)
CREATE INDEX outbox_events_queue ON outbox_events (status, created_at)
